method.response: the row's worst err (exp256's deposit field worst_err) ranked over the 72 rows — the tied average ranks (scipy.stats.rankdata, exp229's K3 convention)
method.model: OLS with intercept on the tied average ranks; host (12 levels) / arm (2) / seed (3) entered as reference-coded dummies (first level in the deposit's own order dropped; R^2 invariant to the choice — asserted)

method.discriminant: the SEED share ONLY: <= 0.10 DETERMINISTIC-PER-INSTANCE / >= 0.30 NOISE-LIKE / else MIXED
